systems.owner: Commune urbaine de Diffa, with technical support from ANSI and backing from UNDP
systems.tiers: Commune urbaine de Diffa, in service 11 December 2025: tablet census of taxable premises, QR-coded tax notices, mobile-money payment, real-time dashboards; launched in Niamey in 2023

note: UNDP's account of Diffa's municipal tax system; it describes an application and field equipment and names connectivity failures only as a risk learned from Niamey, without stating how the commune's office is connected.
